sections.what_happened: Munir's Oct 20 Tehran mission (carrying the Qatar-backed proposal: confidential IAEA visit in exchange for interest on $6B frozen in Qatar) ended in formal rejection. Rezaei: enriched material stays in Iran ('national asset'); no negotiations until Washington meets conditions and rebuilds trust. Pezeshkian: US must lift threats/sanctions before any talks. Ghalibaf: Washington can't earn trust until it meets Iran's seven conditions; reportedly told Munir 'we have nothing new to say.' A follow-up Qatari delegation left Tehran after ~30 minutes (no breakthrough, per IRGC-linked source). Qatar's FM says mediation contacts continue. Iran preparing for potential 'fourth war.' Separately: Israeli media report Netanyahu instructed the military to work toward overthrowing the Iranian government — single-source, unverified.
sections.what_verified: Reuters, CGTN, Outlook India, news18, JPost agree on the rejection substance; the $6B/IAEA proposal terms now appear in independent outlets (The New Arab, Al-Araby Al-Jadeed via dailyjagran) matching Escobar's earlier account.
sections.what_disputed: thedailyjagran/Al-Araby Al-Jadeed report Washington AND Tehran responded positively to the plan initially — tension with the rejection narrative; hold as competing claims. The Netanyahu instruction is Israeli-media-sourced only.
sections.why_matters: The diplomacy-obituary frame: the last credible compromise plan was walked into Tehran and walked out — while the person it's aimed at (Trump) is simultaneously preparing to release American prisoners with Putin. Update thread, monitor for the next mediator.
sections.context: Background: Iran diplomacy — OUTCOME of the Munir mission (Oct 20): Tehran formally rejects the Qatar-backed compromise proposal (IAEA visit for $6B interest). Rezaei to Munir: not even a small quantity of enriched uranium leaves Iran; no talks until US meets conditions. Ghalibaf: 'nothing new to say.' Qatari delegation left after 30 minutes. Qatar FM says contacts continue. CGTN: Netanyahu reportedly instructed military to plan overthrow of Iranian government (Israeli media, single-source).

totw_analysis: Our read: The diplomacy-obituary frame: the last credible compromise plan was walked into Tehran and walked out — while the person it's aimed at (Trump) is simultaneously preparing to release American prisoners with Putin. Update thread, monitor for the next mediator.
